rules.statement: Registration does not establish with certainty the ownership of a property.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) Registration is not conclusive proof of ownership. (2) Other evidence that is relevant has to be considered. Per Dissanayake, J. "A person whose name is registered as owner of a motor vehicle is deemed to be the owner, only for the purposes of the Registration, that is render him liable to all those duties which the law cast upon the owner of such a motor vehicle." 50 (3) In terms of section 736 of the Civil Procedure Code a contest that arises between the accounting party and any other party in respect of property alleged to belong to the estate, to which the accounting party lays claim, that contest must be tried in the same special proceeding, ie the proceeding for judicial settlement
